limitations: Original120 development paths have already informed design; held-out means disjoint in this diagnostic fit, not fresh blind or external validation.
Each fold fits on96 original complete paths; evaluation targets enter scoring only; evaluation t-1 observation may enter the frozen comparator at decisiont.
The annual3480 rows per channel/horizon are correlated within120 paths; no IID annual-row inference, and overlapping five training folds are not five independent deployment trials.
Fixed state comparator can reveal simple predictive association or underperformance for these quantities; its success or failure neither proves nor refutes every conditional forecast law.

Nominal empirical interval coverage is a marginal fan property on reused development paths. It does not certify conditional trading Q, local action advantage, tail event probability, or10% full-horizon risk.
Remaining-horizon log-quantity prediction improvement is not equivalent to trading-Q improvement or a tested adaptive continuation.
No new financial policy, beta, eta, admission rule, liquidity floor, menu, risk threshold, target or final scenario evaluation is selected or run.
Features and all centering/scaling are training-only and temporally available. No future held-out market observations or labels fit the model.
interval_definition: Training same-calendar 10th to 90th quantiles; numpy linear method; inclusive endpoints. Descriptive marginal interval only.
